summary: Join our Monetary Policy Formulation and Implementation training. Learn to design and execute monetary policies that drive economic stability and growth.
lede: Monetary policy training explains how policy decisions are developed and put into practice to influence inflation, liquidity and financial conditions. It is for policy analysts, economists, researchers and financial stability professionals who need to turn economic evidence into policy recommendations and operational plans. Learners examine inflation and output-gap analysis, assess transmission channels, forecast liquidity, and plan open-market operations and policy communications.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who operate at the intersection of macroeconomic theory and financial market operations.
modules: Inflation Targeting and Output Gap Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of macroeconomics and basic financial market operations. Familiarity with statistical software (such as EViews, Stata, or Python) is recommended but not required, as the course focuses on operational application rather than pure coding. A working knowledge of central bank mandates and basic accounting principles will be beneficial.
